{{samename|[[character of the day]] from ''[[AG047|I Feel Skitty!]]'' whose Japanese name is Arisa|Eliza}} ---- {{Character Infobox |color={{sun color}} |corecolor={{blue color light}} |bordercolor={{sun color dark}} |name=Alisa |jname=アリサ |tmname=Alisa |image=Pokémon Concierge Alisa.jpg |size=250px |caption=Alisa |gender=Female |colors=yes |eyes=Brown |hair=Black |hometown=Unknown |region=Unknown |relatives=Unnamed older sister }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{blue color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Concierge]]'' |debut=''[[PC01|I'm Haru, the New Concierge!]]'' |enva={{wp|Imani Hakim}} |jpva=[[Fairouz Ai]] }} |} '''Alisa''' (Japanese: '''アリサ''' ''Alisa'') is a character in [[Pokémon Concierge]]. She works part-time every summer at the [[Pokémon Resort]]. ==History== Alisa is one of the staff at the [[Pokémon Resort]], working part-time at the place every summer. She greeted Haru on her first day at work and helped her acclimate to the resort by giving her a more casual makeover and showing her around the island. ==Character== Alisa has a laid-back temperament, and doesn't enjoy formalities, telling Haru to not call her "Miss" even though Alisa has been at the Resort longer than her. Alisa is a hard worker and a girl of many talents — she learned rock-climbing when she was in junior high school, and she is also a skilled painter. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Alisa |pkmn=Mudkip |type1=Water |img=Pokémon Concierge Mudkip.png |epnum=PC01 |epname=I'm Haru, the New Concierge! |vajp= |vaen= |desc={{p|Mudkip}} is Alisa's only known Pokémon, although it is sometimes seen on its own. According to Alisa, Mudkip was one of the Pokémon living at the Resort and just started to follow her around and befriend her out of the blue. Mudkip is cheerful and squirts water out of its mouth when it is excited.
